notes: reproducibility_score computed per the standard formula (base_score - sir_confidence_penalty - unmatched_penalty) came out at or below 0.0 primarily because only 2 of 33 published paper metrics were attempted (unmatched_penalty dominates), not solely because the 2 attempted metrics scored badly.
Both attempted metrics (HotpotQA ReAct EM, HotpotQA Act EM) are Critical severity by the >30% deviation threshold.

A trajectory-level analysis (see benchmark_comparison.md, Root Cause Analysis Cause 1) found EM restricted to episodes that actually terminated via finish[...] is 30.4% -- at or above the paper's reported 27.4% -- indicating the bulk of the deviation is driven by a 54% non-termination rate within the 7-step budget, not by fundamentally incorrect reasoning.

score_confidence is 'medium' per the stated rule (1-2 metrics matched); it is not 'low' because both matched pairs are directly comparable (same metric, same dataset, same split intent) with a clear, evidenced root cause, but it is not 'high' because only 2 of 33 result rows were attempted and n=50 is a 10% subsample of the paper's full n=500 HotpotQA set.
